name: FIFTY! YEP!
statusNote: Unchanged in Forever as far as is known: the text, objectives and rewards below are Classic’s.
footerSourceNote: Text, givers, objectives and rewards come from the cMaNGOS Classic database (a reconstruction of the 1.12 world), with what Forever changed on top: the game server’s own answers where we have them, else Wowhead’s Forever database. Places are Classic’s, shown on the Forever maps. Quest text © Blizzard Entertainment.

narrative.details:
I'm going to let you in on a little secret, soldier. Come a little closer.

I'M THE ONLY SANE ONE HERE!

Look at these people! Would you believe that they're all insane!? Well they are! NUTS! CRAZY!

<Oralius lowers his voice.>

Let's just keep that between me, you, and my pal Captain Winky.

<Oralius grabs at the air and squeezes.>

Anyhooooo... I'm collecting badges to go along with my ogre ear collection. Orc is the flavor of the day. Fifty. GO!

<Oralius blows into a horn.>

SHIP IT!
narrative.objectives: Oralius wants 50 Blackrock Medallions. Chances are high that these medallions can be found on the orcs in the Burning Steppes.
narrative.offerRewardText: You've done it! Your reward is: RUB MY BELLY! GO ON! RUB IT!
narrative.requestItemsText:
<Oralius is talking into a rather large, severed ogre ear.>

Burning Steppes to control, come in control.
